{{short description|Chemist, Kurdish journalist}}
'''Gurbetelli Ersöz''' (1965, [[Palu, Elazığ|Palu]], [[Elazığ Province|Elazığ]]– 8 October 1997,<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Diaries as a space of histories|url=http://www.documenta14.de/en/calendar/23768/diaries-as-a-space-of-histories|access-date=2020-08-17|website=www.documenta14.de|language=en}}</ref> [[Iraqi Kurdistan|South Kurdistan]]) was a chemist, journalist and later also member of the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] (PKK).

== Biography ==
Gurbetelli was born in [[Palu, Elazığ|Palu]], [[Elazığ Province|Elazığ]], and studied chemistry at the University.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=KOMUN|date=2018-11-20|title="Of Mice and Dance": Diary Entries of a Journalist-Turned-Guerrilla Fighter|url=https://komun-academy.com/2018/11/20/of-mice-and-dance-diary-entries-of-a-journalist-turned-guerrilla-fighter/|access-date=2020-08-17|website=Komun Academy|language=en-GB|archive-date=2020-09-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200920101641/https://komun-academy.com/2018/11/20/of-mice-and-dance-diary-entries-of-a-journalist-turned-guerrilla-fighter/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Later she worked as an assistant at the [[Çukurova University]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Mater|first=Nadire|date=|title=Çernobil ve Gurbetelli Ersöz: Yüreğimi Dağlara Nakşettim|url=https://m.bianet.org/bianet/yasam/155274-cernobil-ve-gurbetelli-ersoz-yuregimi-daglara-naksettim|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=17 August 2020|website=[[Bianet]]}}</ref> As a chemist, she calls the [[Chernobyl disaster|Chernobyl catastrophe]] of 1986 and the [[Halabja chemical attack|chemical attack in Halabja]] in 1988 two major events turning points in her life. Following, she began to get involved politically, she wanted to make a change. Due to her political activities,<ref name=":0" /> she was arrested in 1990, and prosecuted and sentenced for supporting the PKK.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=CASE OF ÖZGÜR GÜNDEM v. TURKEY|url=https://www.hr-dp.org/files/2013/09/09/CASE_OF_OZGUR_GUNDEM_v._TURKEY_.pdf|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=17 August 2020|website=HUDOC|page=6}}</ref> She stayed in prison for two years.<ref name=":0" /> After her release, she became the editor-in-chief of ''[[Özgür Gündem]]'', a newspaper which showed the Kurdish side of the [[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish-Turkish conflict]].<ref name=":1" /> But her tenure was short-lived as she was detained with 107 other people during a search of the newspapers headquarters in [[Istanbul]] on the 10 December 1993.<ref name=":4" /> Eventually she was arrested on the 12 January 1994.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web|title=Gurbetelli Ersöz|url=https://cpj.org/data/people/gurbetelli-ersoz/|access-date=2020-08-17|website=Committee to Protect Journalists|language=en-US}}</ref> During the trial the prosecutor demanded up to 15 years imprisonment.<ref name=":6" /> Gurbetelli and the other prosecuted journalists were supported by the [[Committee to Protect Journalists]]<ref name=":5" /> and writers like [[Harold Pinter]] or [[Noam Chomsky]].<ref name=":6">{{Cite web|date=1994-06-14|title=Letter: Persecution of Turkish journalists|url=http://www.independent.co.uk/voices/letter-persecution-of-turkish-journalists-1422563.html|access-date=2020-08-17|website=The Independent|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |date=2020-10-08 |title=Kurdish Women Journalists Day |url=https://medyanews.net/kurdish-women-journalists-day/ |access-date=2022-04-01 |website=Medya News |language=en-US}}</ref> She was sentenced to 3 Years and 9 months imprisonment but released in June 1994.<ref name=":7" /> After she was not allowed no work as a journalist, she joined the PKK in 1995.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=Elective Affinities: Diaries as a space of histories with Banu Cennetoglu, Katerina Tselou, Arnisa Zeqo {{!}} American School of Classical Studies at Athens|url=https://www.ascsa.edu.gr/events/details/elective-affinities-diaries-as-a-space-of-histories-with-banu-cennetoglu-ka|access-date=2020-08-17|website=www.ascsa.edu.gr}}</ref> She was killed in combat on the 8 October 1997.<ref name=":1" />

A case was opened at the [[European Court of Human Rights]] in 1998 mentioning her together with other former staff members of ''Özgür Gündem''. The court decided not to consider her being a applicant to the court as she has died in 1997.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=CASE OF ÖZGÜR GÜNDEM v. TURKEY|url=https://www.hr-dp.org/files/2013/09/09/CASE_OF_OZGUR_GUNDEM_v._TURKEY_.pdf|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=17 August 2020|website=HUDOC|page=12}}</ref> 

== Legacy ==
Gurbetelli is seen as a proficient journalist in the Kurdish society and within the [[Musa Anter]] and Free Press Martyrs Journalism Awards of the Free Journalists Association of Turkey, there exists a Gurbetelli Award in her memory. To the award ceremony of 2016, several politicians of the [[Peoples' Democratic Party (Turkey)|Peoples Democratic Party]] (HDP) attended.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Musa Anter journalism awards given|url=https://anfenglish.com/news/musa-anter-journalism-awards-given-16508|access-date=2020-08-17|website=ANF News|language=en}}</ref> The Press Academy of the PKK also bears her name.<ref>{{Cite web|title="Fîraz Dağ" press training program of the guerrillas ends|url=https://anfenglish.com/kurdistan/firaz-dag-press-training-program-of-the-guerrillas-ends-25954|access-date=2020-08-17|website=ANF News|language=en}}</ref> The visual artist [[Banu Cennetoğlu]] presented an art work about her [[diary]] at the [[Documenta 14]] in [[Athens]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=ARTISTS FROM TURKEY FEATURED AT DOCUMENTA 14 – Exhibist|url=https://exhibist.com/artists-from-turkey-featured-at-documenta-14/|access-date=2020-08-17|language=en-US}}</ref> Her diary was published in Germany in 1998 and called ''I Engraved My Heart into the Mountains''<ref name=":2" /> and in 2014 the book was also published in Turkey, but soon after the book was banned by the Turkish authorities.<ref name=":3" />
